page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 4 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tier of modern cloud hardware. In stress-ng CPU tests, both single-core and multi-core performance rank in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show weak to poor performance, with large-block read operations falling into the bottom 10% at 19.1 GB/sec. Similarly, Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores are in the bottom 10%, reflecting its older Intel Xeon architecture. Cryptographic and integer operations are supported via hardware flags like AES, AVX, and AVX512F, though overall processing throughput remains modest.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation but lower-tier benchmark results, the ecs.sn1ne.xlarge represents an entry-level compute-focused option. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources without demanding high memory density or rapid I/O throughput. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, basic database operations, simple text processing, and minor software compilation tasks that do not exceed its 8.0 GB memory limit.
